description: Benchmark task (docs/benchmark_rules.md, brief 2026-10-30). Infineon adsbenchmark chopped LDO (LDO.pdf: 1.5 V from VDDA, Vref 1.2 V, 1 uA bias, 400 kHz clock, 0-25 mA, CL 1 pF, OV / UV flags), sky130 5 V devices. The repository has no measured results: targets are the documented values (Table 1 output voltage, UV / OV flag thresholds, Fig. 7 comparator hysteresis) with the 10 % tolerance, plus the pass limits of ldo_checker.va (output window +-5 mV after every stimulus step, settling 7 mV, idle output 10 mV, flags) for the test sequence the repository documents but gives no numbers for (test ids 7-10). The stimulus is the checker's own (supply / Vref / load steps, disable, clock). SUPPLY: the documented 2.5 V does not work on the exported 5 V devices (see onboarding_status crucial_questions); the task runs at VDDA = 3.3 V and every supply-referred number (UV / OV thresholds, the checker's supply steps) is the documented value x 1.32 (= 3.3 / 2.5).

source.title: Infineon adsbenchmark, LDO (cell_ldo): chopped LDO 2.5 V -> 1.5 V, github.com/Infineon/adsbenchmark commit d1f5c9be021970e8c1fda5a2c5eea3987cb9667c, LDO/doc/LDO.pdf (Figs. 2-6, Tables 1-2) and LDO/src (tb_ldo.hsp, ldo_checker.va)
source.figure: Fig. 2 (top level), Fig. 3 (SC filter), Fig. 4 (source follower), Fig. 5 (chopped op-amp), Fig. 6 (OV/UV comparator) of LDO.pdf

input_voltage_V.provenance: CURATOR CHOICE (rule D7, crucial question 1): the paper VDDA is 2.5 V (LDO.pdf Table 2, ldo_checker / tb_ldo.hsp vsup2v5); at 2.5 V the exported sky130 g5v0d10v5 devices do not regulate (Vout 1.363 V, onboarding_status.port_proof); 3.3 V = the standard 5 V-device rail, within the 5.5 V rating

reference_V.provenance: paper: LDO.pdf Table 1 vref_ai 1.2 V; ldo_checker.va vref_nom = 1.2

load_resistance_ohm.provenance: repository: tb_ldo.hsp R5 = 75 ohm (20 mA at 1.5 V; the checker's +-5 mA steps give 15 / 25 mA)

load_current_A.provenance: 75 ohm at 1.5 V (the nominal load); only a family placeholder, the recipes use load_resistance_ohm

load_capacitance_F.provenance: repository: tb_ldo.hsp C2 = 1 pF (README: 'the testbench uses 1 pF'); the circuit is capacitor-less

clock_frequency_Hz.provenance: paper: LDO.pdf Table 1 clk_i / Table 2 f = 400 kHz; ldo_checker.va fclk

constraints.name: reg_err_supply

constraints.name: reg_err_enable
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points

constraints.name: reg_err_vref
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: checker limit: +-5 mV around 1.5 V + 1.5/1.2 x (+-50 mV) with Vref stepped, and around 1.5 V after Vref returns (LDO.pdf Sec. 8 tests 7 and 8)

constraints.name: reg_err_load
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: checker limit: +-5 mV with the load stepped +5 mA (25 mA) and -5 mA (15 mA) around the 75 ohm / 20 mA load, and back (LDO.pdf Sec. 8 tests 9 and 10; Table 2 Iout 0-25 mA)

constraints.name: settle_dev_max
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: checker limit: ldo_checker.va maxdiff = 7 mV, |Vout(t + 10 us) - Vout(t)| at every settling check (Table 3 test id 9 'output voltage has not settled')

constraints.name: idle_vout_max
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: checker limit: ldo_checker.va maxidle = 10 mV, output when disabled and 5 us into a +-0.3 V x 1.32 supply fault (Table 3 test id 7)

constraints.name: flag_errors
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points

constraints.name: checker_failures
constraints.aggregate: worst case over all conditions and matching points
constraints.provenance: the repository's own pass / fail: the number of checks of ldo_checker.va that fail on this waveform (LDO.pdf Sec. 9: test id 0 if everything is within the specification)
